verdict.rationale: Lever's marketing docs claim 'custom, flexible configurations' and an Automation Hub that auto-archives, tags, emails, and advances candidates, which implies configurable stage-based workflows, but no evidence explicitly confirms drag-and-drop candidate movement or bulk multi-candidate actions across a pipeline. missing for 10: explicit documentation of drag-to-move UI, explicit bulk-action tooling across pipeline, per-job custom stage configuration screenshots/specs.
